statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and irregular heart rhythm
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
CPT code 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) was billed
The denial reason code is PR-204
Continuous Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is required to assess arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation therapy
